description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing 'devices' in a web application using Flask, Flask-Smorest, and MongoDB. It includes schema definitions for device data, and class-based views for CRUD operations, with detailed request/response handling.

classes.name: DeviceSchema
classes.description: Schema for a complete device document, used for creation and full replacement.

classes.name: PartialDeviceSchema
classes.description: Schema for partial updates to a device, all fields optional.

classes.name: ListQuerySchema
classes.description: Schema for query parameters used in listing devices, including filtering, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: DevicesCollection
classes.description: Class-based view handling POST (create) and GET (list) operations for device collection.

classes.name: DeviceItem
classes.description: Class-based view handling GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE operations for individual device identified by ID.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Create a new device document in the database.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a list of devices with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a specific device by its ID.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Replace an existing device by ID with new data.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Partially update a device by ID.
